Eve (marketing): Live update: SnackLab OSS post went out at 08:20 PT. Quick idea: short technical webinar + gated appendix to convert more engineers.
Ravi (devrel): Congrats! Any early metrics?
Eve (marketing): 10h: 2.1k pageviews, 140 newsletter signups, 6 repo stars, 3 demo requests.
Marta (growth): Nice. Where are demo requests from?
Eve (marketing): 2 startups, 1 mid-market. Most signups from inline CTA.
lead-bot: 2 leads failed routing: missing "utm_source" -> parked in manual-review.
Jules (ops): We can default missing utm_source -> "organic" and tag 'auto-defaulted'. I'll stage the change and reprocess after smoke.
Ravi (devrel): Also, add a bench clarification in the post: current latency is single-request (batch=1) on small dedicated; clarify batching increases throughput.
Eve (marketing): Good call. Proposed A/B CTAs on the page: Variant A "Register: live workshop" vs Variant B "Get the repo + appendix". Track CTR -> reg -> demo.
Marta (growth): I'll set up registration and $400 promo test.
Jules (ops): Reprocess command I'll run after deploy:
```bash
python tools/reprocess_leads.py --filter missing_utm_source --assign default:organic --tag auto-defaulted
```
Ravi (devrel): Webinar agenda: 10m intro, 25m demo, 15m benchmarks & infra tips, 10m Q&A. Rafael for runtime deep-dive? I'll ping him.
Eve (marketing): Action list:
- Eve: update post with bench note + add CTA A/B (EOD)
- Jules: deploy routing default + reprocess leads (today)
- Ravi: confirm speakers + outline (tomorrow)
- Marta: reg page + promo (48h)
Eve (marketing): Please update this thread when each task is done so SDRs can pick leads. :rocket:
